items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: Well, that's Bunk, you know, his fellow here, Bunk Johnson and Billy Marrera, and Louis Nelson, myself, Buddy Johnson.

ctx.x: Yeah, sure. Yeah. How about your two brothers? Did they start playing after you or before you? After me, yeah. After you. Uh-huh. What was the first band you started playing with?

Well, the first band I started was, let's see, the Superior, I think, was the first band. And then I played with Papa Celestine, you know, different fellows. Remember who was in the Superior? Well, that's Bunk, you know, his fellow here, Bunk Johnson and Billy Marrera, and Louis Nelson, myself, Buddy Johnson.

items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: Now, the funny thing about Bunk, when he was with us downtown, the Superior Band, he didn't drink, he didn't have no bad habits at all.

ctx.x: Well, a fella by the name of Edwild Clemmen, at that time. And then, later on, Bunk went with the Eagle Band, too. Now, the funny thing about Bunk, when he was with us downtown, the Superior Band, he didn't drink, he didn't have no bad habits at all. And when he went uptown with the Eagle Band, they ruined him. He started drinking and he went all the pieces, you know? Just ruined himself. It showed you a different environment, you understand? Mm-hmm.
When he was with the Superior, was he a good reader?
